name: Agentic RAG
short_description: An evolution of retrieval-augmented generation in which the language model plans, chooses data sources, evaluates retrieved results and queries again in a loop instead of answering from a single retrieval pass.

evidence.quote: A genetic rag turns the LLM from a responder into a decision maker.
the language model decides what context it even needs. It chooses which data source to query first.
There are two main patterns, classic Ragn and AgenteGrag, which one you pick depends on what you're building.
The second big shift is a "agentic rag"
And AI search for possibility to have also a Chandicrack.
